div.head: Abt 9
div.ab: Gif frigman freum stelþ, III gebete, 7 cyning age þæt wite 7 ealle þa æhtan.
Gif frigman freum stelþ, III gebete, 7 cyning age þæt wite 7 ealle þa æhtan.
If a freeman steals from a freeman, let him pay 3[-fold], and the king obtains that fine or all the possessions.
If a freeman robs a freeman, he shall pay a three fold compensation, and the king shall take the fine, or all [the man’s] goods.
Wenn ein Freier einem Freien [etwas] stiehlt, büsse er [diesem] 3[fachen Werth], und der König erhalte die Strafsumme und alle die Güter [des Verbrechers].
If a freeman steals [something] from a freeman, let him compensate [him] 3[-fold value], and let the king receive the fine and all the goods [of the offender].
